definitions.explanation: Something designed to be folded for compact storage or transport. Used as a noun modifier to describe items that can be folded.

examples.japanese: {折|お}りたたみ{傘|がさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っていく→持っていく：27431_motteiku⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{折|お}りたたみ{式|しき}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{持|も}ち{込|こ}める→持ち込む：04226_mochikomu⟧。
examples.english: This bicycle is the folding type, so you can bring it on the train.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{狭|せま}い→狭い：00750_semai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{使|つか}わない→使う：00473_tsukau⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{折|お}りたたみ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦テーブル→テーブル：04488_teeburu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{片付|かたづ}けている→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧。
examples.english: Since my room is small, I put away the folding table when I'm not using it.

notes:
{折|お}りたたみ is derived from the verb {折|お}りたたむ (to fold up). It describes items designed to be folded for compact storage or transport.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {折|お}りたたみ{傘|がさ}: folding umbrella
- {折|お}りたたみ⟦{椅子|いす}→椅子：00706_isu⟧: folding chair
- {折|お}りたたみ{式|しき}: folding type/style
- {折|お}りたたみ⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧: folding bicycle
- {折|お}りたたみ⟦テーブル→テーブル：04488_teeburu⟧: folding table

USAGE:
Almost always used as a noun modifier before another noun. Rarely used on its own. Adding {式|しき} (style/type) emphasizes the mechanical design rather than simply describing the product.

WRITING:
Sometimes written ⟦{折|お}り{畳|たた}み→折り畳む：12803_oritatamu⟧, but the hiragana form {折|お}りたたみ is more common in everyday use.
